course.title: Introduction to Git
course.description: Learn the handful of Git commands you actually use every day.

chapters.title: Why Version Control
chapters.content:
# Why Version Control

Version control records every change to your code so you can see what changed, when, and why — and undo it when you need to.

- **History**: every commit is a checkpoint you can return to.
- **Collaboration**: several people can work on the same project without overwriting each other.

chapters.title: Your First Commit
chapters.content:
# Your First Commit

```bash
git init
git add README.md
git commit -m "Add README"
```

`git init` creates the repository, `git add` stages the file and `git commit` records it in history.
